edges: Tina Fey plays the role of Liz Lemon in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Carrie Fisher guest stars as Rosemary Howard in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Alec Baldwin plays Jack Donaghy in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Tracy Morgan plays Tracy Jordan in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Jane Krakowski plays Jenna Maroney in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Jack Burditt wrote the episode Rosemary's Baby.
Michael Engler directed the episode Rosemary's Baby.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Alec Baldwin won the Primetime Emmy Award for his role in the episode Rosemary's Baby.
